name: Infernal Hosts
worldbuilding: Demonic legions, corrupted mortal warriors, infernal cults, and summoned horrors. Their armies gain explosive advantages through sacrifice, unstable magic, and aggressive attacks.

factionRule.name: Dark Bargain
factionRule.effect: Once per activation, a friendly Infernal Unit may suffer 1 Damage to reroll one die, obeying the normal once-per-die reroll limitation.

factionCommands.name: Unbound Power
factionCommands.effect: One Attack gains +2 Attacks. If it Blunders, its Unit suffers 1 Damage.

factionCommands.name: Blood Offering
factionCommands.effect: Damage or remove one friendly basic Model. One nearby friendly Unit gains Accurate 2 on its next Attack.

factionCommands.name: Open the Rift
factionCommands.effect: Deploy one eligible, already paid-for minor Infernal Unit from Reserve according to its summoning restrictions.

abilities.name: Grim Resolve
abilities.effect: While this Unit has accumulated Damage, its melee Attacks gain Anti-Mortal 1.

abilities.name: Rift Step
abilities.effect: May begin in Reserve and deploy outside Short Range of enemies at the end of a Round.

abilities.name: Expendable
abilities.effect: This Unit may be chosen as the sacrifice for Blood Offering without further restriction; when sacrificed this way, remove only one Model rather than damaging a Model of another Unit.

abilities.name: Blood Debt
abilities.effect: If the Champion inflicted at least 2 Damage on enemies during its preceding activation, Heal 1 on one friendly Infernal Unit within Short.

captainAndSpecialists.name: Riftcaller

abilities.name: Warp Eruption
abilities.effect: On 3+, inflict Direct Damage 1 on a visible enemy within Medium. On a natural 6, inflict Direct Damage 2 instead.

upgrades.name: Warp Breach
upgrades.effect: Instead of making a Spell Attack, place a 25mm token within Medium Range. At the end of the Combat Phase, every Unit with at least half its surviving Models (rounded up) within 1.5" of the token suffers two automatic Magic Hits at Damage 1 each, total. Resolve Armor then Ward; no Evade. Resolve Saves separately against each Hit. The effect applies to friendly and enemy Units alike. Remove the token after resolving its effect.

captainAndSpecialists.note: The Riftcaller and Blood Priest could have different Mortal or Infernal traits depending on their finalized lore.

captainAndSpecialists.name: Blood Priest

abilities.name: Unholy Benediction
abilities.effect: One friendly Infernal Unit within Short gains Ward 6+ against Magic, or improves its existing Magic Ward by one step, until the end of the Round. It suffers 1 Damage at the end of that Round unless it destroyed an enemy Model.

captainAndSpecialists.note: The Riftcaller and Blood Priest could have different Mortal or Infernal traits depending on their finalized lore.

abilities.name: Unstable Power
abilities.effect: Once per Round, suffer Direct Damage 1 to gain +2 Attacks during the next Melee Attack.

abilities.name: Volatile Gate
abilities.effect: On a Blunder, suffer Direct Damage 1.

factionLeader.name: Archfiend

abilities.name: Ruin Made Flesh
abilities.effect: The Archfiend's Dark Bargain may reroll up to two dice instead of one for the same 1 Damage.

abilities.name: Open the Hellgate
abilities.effect: Deploy up to two eligible, already paid-for minor Infernal Units from Reserve outside Medium Range of enemies, obeying normal summoning restrictions.

knownIssues: Unlike every other Faction Leader in this file, the Archfiend's entry has no printed Unit-type tags (e.g. 'Hero, Infernal, Armored') in the source — only the profile line. This may simply be a formatting omission (it is clearly intended to be a Hero/Infernal/Monster-scale Unit) rather than a deliberate design choice.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Mortal cultists represented by generic infantry, ranged auxiliaries, conventional cavalry, Medics, and Scouts. Signature troops are expensive and aggressive, while generic followers provide numbers and objectives.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Cultist Horde as the faction's Extra Core, a disposable Horde Infantry unit explicitly reinforcing the Dark Bargain/Blood Offering sacrifice identity rather than patching a weakness (its weapon profile was kept unchanged, following this chapter's established horde-buff pattern of Models not Attacks). Other Damage-1 weapons gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Elite on the Greater Fiend's Daemon Weapon, Anti-Armored on the Archfiend's Hellforged Claws) or an improved Hit (Daemon Blade 4+ -> 3+, Rift Battery 5+ -> 4+).
